messages:
alex_cheng: quick question — partner's healthcheck needs to hit our private VPCE (vpce-0a1b2c) for onboarding. They asked if we can add 203.0.113.45/32 to the prod-private SG outbound for ~72h. logs currently include src IPs; do we need to redact anything before we approve?

maria_lopez: can you paste the exact rule you want to add and confirm why outbound vs inbound? is the check coming from their side to our endpoint or we pulling?

alex_cheng: it's their monitor hitting our private endpoint (they call our VPCE dns). so inbound from their IP to our endpoint. sample change: 
```
Ingress: sg-prod-private allow tcp 443 from 203.0.113.45/32 (Temporary - 72h)
```
we have VPC flow logs enabled to s3 — the logs include src_ip. partner asked for minimal exposure but they need the check to succeed.

samir_khan: short answer: ok with controls, but don't add to global 0.0.0.0/0 or long-lived. prefer: 1) endpoint policy on the VPCE to restrict callers, 2) tag-based short-lived SG rule named partner/onboard/203-0-113-45, 3) create infra ticket for change + 72h auto-expire script.

for logs: default is to keep src_ip in flow logs. if partner requires masking, we treat that as PII request — need PO + legal signoff. We can also pseudonymize at ingestion: e.g., hash(src_ip) in the pipeline before storing, but that removes troubleshooting fidelity.

steps I recommend: 
- open infra change ticket and link PR for SG rule (jessica_ops to implement)
- add a VPCE endpoint policy that limits the accepted caller ARN/ips if possible
- create a CloudWatch Event scheduled run to remove the SG rule at +72h (or set TTL in our infra-as-code)
- if partner insists on redaction, escalate to privacy for approval, and implement hashing pipeline with retention policy.

will also need sec review + approver (samir_khan) to sign off on ticket.

jessica_ops: i'll open the infra ticket now and include the auto-expire script snippet. linking here when done.

sec-bot: Reminder: changes that relax inbound network controls require a written exception and must include rollback plan. See https://redwood.internal/security/network-exceptions

alex_cheng: thanks — putting the CIDR and TTL in the PR. tagging @samir_khan for final approval. :thumbsup:

samir_khan: approve with the conditions above. make sure the infra PR includes: endpoint policy diff, SG rule with tag, CloudWatch scheduled removal, and test steps. if partner asks to mask IPs, route to privacy — we'll prefer hashing over full redaction only after signoff.

jessica_ops: ticket created: https://tickets.redwood.ai/INC-5421 - PR link in the ticket. will target change in the 11:30 maintenance window and set removal at +72h.

alex_cheng: perfect, thanks everyone. I'll monitor logs during the window and report back.
